### Global Metadata
A complete 110-second relaxed daytime background piece for freely exploring a sunny Japanese residential shopping street and a shared community courtyard, in the spirit of a slice-of-life anime or Studio Ghibli town theme. 92 BPM, G major, cheerful but calm and unhurried, never distracting from gameplay. Acoustic nylon-string guitar arpeggios, a warm upright piano melody, light glockenspiel accents, a soft wooden recorder or flute for the second theme, round acoustic bass, brushed snare and a gentle shaker groove. Bright natural acoustic mix, dry-sunny atmosphere, small-room warmth. Pure instrumental acoustic ensemble piece. Avoid EDM drops, trap hi-hats, distorted guitars, heavy sub bass, trailer braams and cinematic bombast.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: piano and recorder share the melody like a friendly conversation; the guitar keeps a steady fingerpicked pulse throughout.

### Timed Arrangement
0-16 seconds: nylon guitar and soft piano chords establish the groove. 16-48 seconds: the main theme on piano with bass and brushes entering, glockenspiel adds small sparkles at phrase ends. 48-80 seconds: the recorder or flute takes the melody, piano plays a light counter-line, shaker adds motion. 80-104 seconds: a short bridge with light strings and a modulation-free lift, still relaxed. 104-120 seconds: return to the main theme on piano, ending cleanly on the tonic without a fade so the track can loop smoothly. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 110 seconds and must not end early.
